newsitem.title: USA: First Western completes credit card portfolio sale.
newsitem.headline: First Western completes credit card portfolio sale.

text.p: First Western Bancorp Inc Tuesday said during the first quarter it completed the sale of its remaining $17 million in credit card receivables at an after-tax gain of approximately $3.1 million, or $0.40 per share, to a leading U.S. credit card issuer.

Including the previous gain on the sale of $30 million in credit card receivables during the fourth quarter of 1996, the total net after-tax gain on the sale of credit card receivables was approximately $7.8 million, or $1.00 per share.

"The completion of our credit card loan sale gives us a valuable opportunity to reinvest proceeds into more profitable commercial loans," said Thomas J. O'Shane, First Western's chairman, president and chief executive officer. "We expect to start capitalizing on this opportunity throughout 1997.

"In the short run, our efforts to boost net interest income will be challenged by the recent increase in short-term interest rates, which increases our costs of funds. Nevertheless, we are confident that our strategic restructuring of our loan portfolio will begin to benefit our net interest margin in the year ahead."
